v5.9.72 - Career Run Archive
Added ----- - New Career Runs tab in the Remote Log Viewer archives completed regular (non-parent-farming) career runs: trainee name, scenario, career rank/rating, race record, fans, skill points, and final stats. - The Remote Log Viewer now pushes a live update over its WebSocket whenever a regular career run completes, so the Career Runs tab refreshes automatically instead of only on manual refresh or tab switch.
